definitions: The main means of mass communication (broadcasting, publishing, and the internet) regarded collectively.
The plural form of medium, referring to an intervening substance or agency through which something is conveyed or transmitted.
Materials or methods used by an artist.
Nutrient solutions or gels used to culture microorganisms or cells.
examples: The story was widely reported in the media.
Water is the medium for fish.
Oil paint is her preferred medium.
Bacteria grew rapidly in the culture media.
